releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Tell a fork of a session in a tree that courier did not start it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/607
* Tell a parent what OpenCode's own message at a native child's turn end is by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/608
* Release 0.16.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/609


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.3...v0.16.4

## What's Changed
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.3.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/603
* Test OpenCode's reports of native children that are dropped, idle or stopped alone by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/605
* Release 0.16.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/606


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.2...v0.16.3

## Highlights

**A finding reaches the parent while its report waits with a group.** `courier_send` takes a `finding` with a report: what the other parts of the job need from it now (a value, a path, a wrong assumption of the split). When the report is held with a join group, the finding goes to the parent at once, and the parent passes it on to the sessions it affects. The finding stays on the held report too. It goes ahead only while another member of the group has yet to report; on the report that completes the group it arrives with the group's message. (#594, #598)

**A blocked group member sees what the group already holds.** A blocked report from a member of a join group reaches the parent at once, as before, and now brings the reports the group holds from the other members, in case what the blocked session needs is in one of them. (#574)

**A join group is a choice, not the default.** A session that splits its work is no longer told to start its parallel parts in one group. A group is for parts whose reports are of no use one at a time; without one, each report wakes the parent as it comes. The child brief, the `group` description and the skill say so. (#578)

**`courier_send` says what steering does.** A plain send to a working session is read at its next step, after the running tool call returns; nothing running is cut short. `queue` is only for a message that must not be read before the target's turn ends. Models had read the old wording as "a plain send interrupts", and queued findings that then arrived too late. (#585)

## Docs

- The README's demo GIF is recorded again and shows a finding passed on mid-run: a worker's finding wakes its lead, the lead passes it on, and the sibling rewrites its test. The spotlight glides between steps, and a progress line marks the scenes. The narrated video and its scripts are removed. (#588, #599)

## Tests and tooling

- Real-model suite: a new `discovery` check, where a session makes a finding itself and its siblings need it, and fixes to the `discovery` and `recursive` checkers so a failing run waits out no timeout. (#566, #567, #570, #571, #572, #587, #589, #593, #597)
- The live suite's native scenario prompts through the API, and `tui.sh`'s "Today" checks hold across midnight. (#564, #586)
- No comments in code: all removed, and the rule is in CLAUDE.md. (#565)

## What's Changed
* The native scenario prompts through the API, so opencode run's wait on a native child cannot stall it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/564
* No comments in code: remove them all and make it the rule by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/565
* real-model discovery: a finding a session makes itself, passed on to its siblings by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/566
* discovery checker: the parts are told apart by the command each ran, not by the files its task names by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/567
* discovery: the finding is a key made when a part runs, so no session can know it beforehand by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/570
* discovery checker: a failing run waits out no timeout, the parts go on once the key cannot come in time by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/571
* discovery checker: a key the root read from a held report counts, and a part that searched the server's files for it is named by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/572
* A blocked report from a group member brings the reports the group holds from the others by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/574
* A join group is a choice for a pure fan-in: no session is told to group its parallel parts by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/578
* Real-model checkers: a look before the first spawn is not polling by @ivopogace in h

## What's Changed
* Every courier envelope escapes a courier tag in its body, so no session can forge one by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/548
* A session's account of what the person said is not binding by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/550
* real-model.md: results of the full suite at a45369a by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/551
* plugin-api-notes: a prompt's metadata reaches the inbox item; other user items carry none by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/552
* The plugin passes text typed into a spawned session up the tree by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/553
* real-model: the recursive-conflict smoke check by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/554
* e2e/run.sh: E2E_GROUPS selects groups separated by spaces as well as commas by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/555
* real-model review check: reading the stash is not changing the checkout by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/556
* The opencode-release skill: adopt a new OpenCode release in courier by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/558
* real-model fan-out check: an instruction update is no step of a turn by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/559
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.2.7 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/561
* A spawned session that waits on an outside wake-up tells its parent and schedules a check-in by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/562
* Release 0.16.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/563


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.0...v0.16.1

## What's Changed
* Add the courier-egm-loop skill: EGM rounds on the skill until none is found by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/499
* A session's own check-in, firing after it reported, does not make it owe a new report by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/507
* courier_stop tells the parent of an idle target that still owed a report by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/509
* Model-facing string corrections from the EGM review (#502-#506) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/508
* Skill: where a change goes below the root; laterText cancels at the last report (#513, #515) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/516
* courier-egm-loop: run every round without the owner by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/519
* courier_stop tells the parent of an idle blocked target; only a check-in scheduled before the report is exempt (#512, #514) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/517
* A reported child stops counting while its turn finishes; the limit refusals say what still counts (#511) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/518
* The child brief says the person's words are the person's word (#520) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/521
* The blocked stop notice says the session still holds back its join group (#523) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/529
* A child's status-less message after its parent reported is not a prompt; the reference names the exempt self-scheduled message (#528, #527) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/530
* A blocked child counts toward the limits; the refusals say what counts (#524, #525, #526) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/531
* Real-model rows after EGM loop rounds 1 and 2; relax the fault checker's ordering; measured SUITE weights by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/532
* The limit refusals say to answer a blocked child first (#534) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/535
* The limit refusals say courier_cleanup drops a blocked child (#537) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/538
* courier_cleanup says a kept worktree's session is dropped only by a second call (#540) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/541
* Real-model tables hold one batch; CLAUDE.md drops the exception for old rows by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/543
* The e2e checks wait on conditions, not fixed times by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/542
* recursive-finding: no session touches the wait files; a half started with the finding counts by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/544
* recursive-finding's row covers both file-wait batches by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/545
* Release 0.16.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/546


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
